detail.longDescription: Next up: my photography website. Currently, it runs as an SPA with client-side routing. While functional, it’s far from optimal for indexing and visual recognition across the web. I’m planning to rebuild the site using Astro for proper Static Site Generation (SSG). Pre-rendering static pages will give the portfolio a massive boost in loading performance, clean metadata, and reliable image discovery. # AstroJS # WebDev # Photography # WebPerformance
